limitations: Automatic repair is paused if remaining-date meals have DONE/SKIPPED logs or the source plan has purchased ingredients. Preserving these records is tested; reconciling them into a replacement is not implemented.
Component checks are not authenticated browser E2E.
Five-second visible polling plus request latency is not instant server push.
Draft questions and unfinished notes stay in bounded session memory and clear on account change/reload.
No clinical validation or cross-member automatic clinical approval reuse.
